# awscc_personalize_recommender (Resource)

A recommender for a Domain dataset group that generates recommendations using a domain use case recipe.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_group_arn` (String) The ARN of the Domain dataset group that the recommender is created for.
- `name` (String) The name of the recommender.
- `recipe_arn` (String) The ARN of the recipe (Domain dataset group use case) that the recommender uses.

### Optional

- `recommender_config` (Attributes) The configuration details of the recommender. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recommender_config))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to associate with the recommender. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `creation_date_time` (String) The time at which the recommender was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_updated_date_time` (String) The time at which the recommender was last updated.
- `recommender_arn` (String) The ARN of the recommender.
- `status` (String) The status of the recommender.

<a id="nestedatt--recommender_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recommender_config`

Optional:

- `enable_metadata_with_recommendations` (Boolean) Whether metadata with recommendations is enabled for the recommender.
- `item_exploration_config` (Map of String) Specifies the exploration configuration hyperparameters.
- `min_recommendation_requests_per_second` (Number) Specifies the requested minimum provisioned recommendation requests per second.
- `training_data_config` (Attributes) The training data configuration to use when creating a domain recommender. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recommender_config--training_data_config))

<a id="nestedatt--recommender_config--training_data_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recommender_config.training_data_config`

Optional:

- `excluded_dataset_columns` (Map of List of String) Specifies the columns to exclude from training. Each key is a dataset type, and each value is a list of columns.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_personalize_recommender.example
  identity = {
    recommender_arn = "recommender_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `recommender_arn` (String) The ARN of the recommender

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_personalize_recommender.example
  id = "recommender_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_personalize_recommender.example "recommender_arn"
```
